pla-01.prompt: Flat two-dimensional educational illustration. Simple closed shapes, clear dark outlines, completely solid uniform fills. No gradients, shading or texture. Complete adult person standing beside a whole simple wooden chair, pulling empty trouser pockets outward with worried expression. A blue wallet lies under chair with a small red pointer arrow. LOST object, flat solid fills dark outlines, whole figure and chair, no question marks, text or numbers. Single square CACE vocabulary image. Pure white background. Show every subject and essential prop whole inside the middle two thirds of the canvas. Zoom OUT, leave one sixth of canvas width empty at both sides, generous white above and below. Natural anatomically correct hands. Plain shoes and clothing. No border. Absolutely no text, writing, letters, numbers, labels, brand marks, emblems, logos or watermarks anywhere.
